VibeWrite2.demoUserMsg1: Help me write a tweet about the AI Agent trend in crypto this week
VibeWrite2.demoAssistantMsg1:
Here are 3 versions for you:

🔍 Insightful:
"AI Agents aren't just hype anymore — they're settling trades, managing portfolios, and negotiating on-chain."

😏 Witty:
"2024: 'AI will replace developers'
2025: 'AI agents will replace traders'
2026: The agents are arguing with each other on CT and honestly they're making better points than most of us"

💬 Casual:
"Been watching AI agents evolve in crypto and honestly it's wild. We're still super early on this one."
VibeWrite2.demoUserMsg2: I like the witty one! Can you make it shorter and punchier?
VibeWrite2.demoAssistantMsg2:
Sure! Here's a tighter version:

"2024: AI replaces devs
2025: AI replaces traders
2026: AI agents are on CT making better takes than all of us

We're not ready for this conversation."

📊 218 characters — well within the limit.
